matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies a mathematical inconsistency in the logits fusion equation in Section 4.2, specifically that the claim about weights summing to 1 is unsupported. This detects the same defect as GT1, which concerns conflicting formulas in adaptive logits fusion that contradict the described balancing principle. Both point to the same material (the fusion equation) and identify an inconsistency between the formula and the claimed properties, satisfying R1 and R3.

No finding addresses the attention reallocation mechanism or causal masking constraints. Finding 1 focuses exclusively on the logits fusion equation, not on attention reallocation formulas or autoregressive consistency issues.
